Formal Government Submission

Proposal for a 50-Site 5G NR n50 (1.5 GHz) Fixed Wireless Broadband Network

Submitted to the Office of the Secretary, Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) • 9 November 2026

1. Executive Proposal & Non-Recoverable Government CAPEX Structure (Strictly 50 n50 Sites)

We respectfully propose a strictly 50-base-station 5G NR Band n50 (1.5 GHz / 1432–1517 MHz TDD) Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) network in DICT-selected unserved and underserved areas, targeting the top 50 high-density unserved clusters identified across all 3,355 unserved and underserved barangays nationwide (2,647 Tier 1 True Unserved barangays with zero MNO 4G/5G and zero FTTH, plus 708 Tier 2 Underserved barangays with <5 Mbps cellular and zero FTTH). Across these 50 clusters, the 50 n50 base stations (6.0 km cell radius) cover 473 unserved/underserved barangays (9.5 barangays/site), 836,264 citizens, and 175,820 estimated households (averaging 3,516 households per BTS site based on PSA 2020 CPH regional household sizes).

Under this model, the Government does not recover the CAPEX it infuses (treating the 50-site infrastructure and demand-led household CPEs as a non-recoverable social infrastructure grant), while the competitively selected Operating Partner funds 100% of recurring OPEX. Optimum retail pricing and minimum subscriber thresholds to break-even and ROI are therefore determined strictly from OPEX:

  • Non-Recoverable Government CAPEX Grant (0% Tariff Recovery): USD 12,794,900 (PHP 767.694M excl. VAT | PHP 863.656M incl. 12.5% VAT) for the 50 Co-Located n50 Base Stations ($255,898/site), plus demand-led household CPE kits at USD 55 (PHP 3,300) per connected household.
  • Core Network CAPEX Removed ($0 Core CAPEX → ₱10.00/Subscriber Monthly Supplier Fee): Saves USD 2,805,000 (PHP 168.300M excl. VAT) in upfront Core CAPEX; instead, the Core Supplier is paid PHP 10.00 per active subscriber per month in OPEX.
  • Simplified Spectrum User Fee (₱5.00/Subscriber Monthly SUF): In lieu of the established NTC SUF, regulatory SUF is PHP 5.00 per active subscriber per month (total variable per-subscriber OPEX = ₱15.00/subscriber/month).
  • Annual Fixed Site OPEX (50 Sites): USD 3,252,000/yr (PHP 195.120M/yr = PHP 325,200/site/mo) under Solar-Hybrid Optimized OPEX (where the 16kW Solar + 450AH Li-Ion battery bank offsets 60% of commercial electricity and diesel), or USD 4,800,000/yr (PHP 288.000M/yr = PHP 480,000/site/mo) under unadjusted Base Spreadsheet OPEX.

2. OPEX-Only Optimum Tariff Mechanisms & Minimum Subscribers to Break-Even / Operator ROI

Because zero CAPEX recovery is loaded onto retail tariffs, both the Optimum 4-Tier Cross-Subsidized Mix (₱1,069 Gross → ₱910.83/mo Net after VAT, 3% loss, ₱5 SUF & ₱10 Core fee) and the Affordable GIDA Social-First Mix (40% @ ₱499, 45% @ ₱699, 15% @ ₱1,299 → ₱709 Gross / ₱599.04/mo Net after fees) achieve rapid OPEX Break-Even and sustainable Operator ROI across a small fraction of the 175,820 estimated households:

  • Optimum 4-Tier Mix (₱1,069 Gross / ₱910.83 Net after ₱15 Fees): 100% OPEX Break-Even at 12,911 connected households (258 HH/site = 7.3% of 175,820 Est. HHs) under Solar+Anchor, 17,852 HHs (357/site = 10.2% HHs) under Solar Retail-Only, or 26,350 HHs (527/site = 15.0% HHs) under Base OPEX. +20% Operator Net Margin (1.25x OPEX) at 16,139 connected households (323 HH/site = 9.2% HHs) under Solar+Anchor, 22,315 HHs (446/site = 12.7% HHs) under Solar Retail-Only, or 32,937 HHs (659/site = 18.7% HHs) under Base OPEX.
  • Affordable GIDA Social-First Mix (₱709 Gross / ₱599.04 Net after ₱15 Fees): 100% OPEX Break-Even at 19,631 connected households (393 HH/site = 11.2% of Est. HHs) under Solar+Anchor, or 27,143 HHs (543/site = 15.4% HHs) under Solar Retail-Only. +20% Operator Net Margin (1.25x OPEX) at 24,539 connected households (491 HH/site = 14.0% HHs) under Solar+Anchor, or 33,929 HHs (679/site = 19.3% HHs) under Solar Retail-Only.
